_why: F38#1 (5.35), F38#2 (5.58), F38#26 (5.77): all three code-blind judges said Meadows creatures 'sit in the shaded tree-trunk band, read as small dark blobs, no rim light'. Cool pale, never red/oxblood. Combat tell auras, boss auras and hit/level-up glows take the overlay slot over the rim and hand it back when they end. Client presentation only; no state, no collision. OFF until GPU judged.
